pages.title: The End Species
pages.text: Bees from The End are elusive and powerful, often requiring high-tier parent species to breed or being found through a Lure.
$(li)Endstone Bee: Produces End Stone.$(br)$(o)Blocks: End Stone, End Stone Bricks.$()$(br)$(li)Ender Bee: Produces Ender Pearls.$(br)$(o)Block: Dragon Egg.$()
